name: Professional Email
description: Writes single professional emails with clear subject lines, the ask stated in the first three sentences, and a structured body for workplace communication. Use when the user needs to write a work email, business correspondence, or professional message to a colleague, manager, client, or vendor. Do NOT use for cold outreach sequences (use `cold-email-outreach`), newsletters (use `newsletter-writing`), or rejection letters (use `rejection-letter`).
